audience: facilities and maintenance teams that keep building, equipment and inventory records in FMX

useCases.title: List the buildings and open one
useCases.text: List the buildings in the FMX tenant. The list has no paging, so a large tenant gives a large reply. Open one building by its id.

useCases.title: Review equipment records and their details
useCases.text: List the equipment records of the tenant. Open one record by its id to read its details.

useCases.title: Look up inventory items
useCases.text: List the inventory items of the tenant. Open one item by its id to read its record.

useCases.title: Read resources and attachment records
useCases.text: List the resources and the attachment records of the tenant. Open one resource or attachment by its id.
